label: About
title: About The Bead Line Holds
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from a saved source, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: a visible mark in the scene opens the real source that shaped the day.

This edition began with one saved post, @trojan_norse: Mark Rothko. Its image from pbs.twimg.com set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became The Bead Line Holds: Multiform color-field drift on a cream-washed linen plane, frontal flat plate, wide landscape. A long horizon of cobalt and crimson bead-dabs crosses the full width as the anchor, splitting two soft fields. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped the source to Full-width horizon row of alternating cobalt and crimson bead-dabs.
